title: Ancillary Equipment
lead: Everything a turnkey line needs around the main machines — boilers, cyclones, airlocks, magnets and ducting from one supplier.
body_paragraphs: Turnkey means the unglamorous equipment arrives too: steam boilers for conditioning, cyclones and airlocks for aspiration, magnets protecting dies and rolls, and the ducting that ties the dust system together.
Specifying it all from one works means every flange, height and airflow is already coordinated before anything ships.
features: Coordinated as part of the turnkey scope
meta_description: Everything a turnkey line needs around the main machines — boilers, cyclones, airlocks, magnets and ducting from one supplier.

title: PLC & Control Panels
lead: From a single batching panel to full-line automation — SEMZON builds the electrical brain of the plant in-house.
body_paragraphs: SEMZON designs and wires PLC and MCC panels for every stage of the plant: batching and mixing first, then grinding, pelleting, cooling and packing brought under one operator screen.
Because panels are built in the same works as the machines, retrofitting automation into a running mill — ours or anyone's — is a routine job, not a science project.
features: MCC and PLC panels built in-house
meta_title: PLC & Control Panels — PLC | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: From a single batching panel to full-line automation — SEMZON builds the electrical brain of the plant in-house.

title: Drum Cleaner
lead: A rotating drum screen that scalps meals and ground materials, catching lumps, string and foreign matter ahead of batching.
body_paragraphs: The rotary drum cleaner handles meals, ground grain and bulk ingredients that need gentle, continuous scalping rather than aggressive screening. Material passes through the rotating perforated drum; clean product falls through while oversize discharges at the end.
It is specified on SEMZON lines wherever soybean meal, canola and by-products enter the process.
features: Continuous rotary scalping of meals and ground material
Easy drum access for screen cleaning
meta_description: A rotating drum screen that scalps meals and ground materials, catching lumps, string and foreign matter ahead of batching.

title: Maize Pre-Cleaner
lead: First defence for the whole plant — cobs, stones, string and oversize trash are pulled out before raw maize touches a machine.
body_paragraphs: The CP pre-cleaner scalps incoming maize and grain at intake rates matched to your dumping pit and elevator, protecting hammer mills, conveyors and pellet dies from tramp material.
Combined with drum cleaning and magnets it forms the Stage 01 cleaning section of every SEMZON feed line.
features: Removes cobs, stones, string and oversize trash
Protects grinding and pelleting equipment downstream
meta_description: First defence for the whole plant — cobs, stones, string and oversize trash are pulled out before raw maize touches a machine.

title: Pellet Cleaner
lead: Separates fines and broken pellets from finished product before packing, so only uniform pellets reach the bag.
body_paragraphs: Positioned after cooling, the pellet cleaner strips fines and fragments from the finished pellet stream and returns them for re-pelleting, protecting pellet durability numbers and bag appearance.
It works alongside the SSLG crumbler and SFJH screener in the Stage 05 screening section of the line.
features: Removes fines and broken pellets before packing
Improves pellet durability index at dispatch
Simple screen change for pellet diameter
meta_description: Separates fines and broken pellets from finished product before packing, so only uniform pellets reach the bag.

title: Bucket Elevator
lead: Vertical lifting matched to your line rate and headroom — the workhorse that moves material between every stage of the plant.
body_paragraphs: SEMZON bucket elevators lift grain, meal and pellets between process floors at capacities matched to the line, with belt speeds and bucket pitch selected per material.
Explosion-relief options, inspection doors and boot cleanout are detailed to keep maintenance simple and the elevator leg safe.
features: Belt and bucket selection per material
Inspection and cleanout access as standard
meta_description: Vertical lifting matched to your line rate and headroom — the workhorse that moves material between every stage of the plant.

title: Chain, Screw & Trough Conveyors
lead: Horizontal and inclined transport — drag chain, screw and trough conveyors fabricated to the exact runs your layout needs.
body_paragraphs: Every SEMZON line is tied together with conveyors fabricated in our own works: en-masse drag chains for gentle high-capacity runs, screws for metering and inclines, troughs where simplicity wins.
Dust-tight covers, intermediate discharge gates and wear liners are specified per duty.
features: Drag chain, screw and trough types
meta_title: Chain, Screw & Trough Conveyors — CONVEY | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: Horizontal and inclined transport — drag chain, screw and trough conveyors fabricated to the exact runs your layout needs.

title: Rotary Distributor
lead: One inlet, many bins — motorised rotary routing that sends material to any silo or bin the recipe calls for.
body_paragraphs: The rotary distributor swings a motorised inner spout across multiple outlet ports, routing incoming material to the selected bin under PLC control.
It removes manual slide-gate juggling above batching bins and finished-product silos alike.
meta_description: One inlet, many bins — motorised rotary routing that sends material to any silo or bin the recipe calls for.

title: Counterflow Cooler
lead: Counterflow air against a settling pellet bed — hot pellets leave within 3–5 °C of ambient, hard, dry and ready to screen.
body_paragraphs: The SKLN cooler draws ambient air upward through a descending bed of hot pellets, so the coolest air always meets the coolest product. Pellets exit within 3–5 °C of ambient with moisture flashed off, protecting durability and safe storage.
Level sensors and a slide-gate discharge keep bed depth — and cooling time — constant regardless of line rate from 6 to 30 t/h.
meta_description: Counterflow air against a settling pellet bed — hot pellets leave within 3–5 °C of ambient, hard, dry and ready to screen.

title: Belt Dryer
lead: Multi-layer belt drying that takes extruded feed down to safe moisture gently and evenly — the partner machine to every extruder.
body_paragraphs: The SHGW belt dryer carries extruded pellets across stacked mesh belts through controlled hot-air zones, drying to target moisture without case-hardening or breaking the product.
Steam and gas heating options match the utilities available at your site.
features: Multi-layer belt design, even residence time
meta_description: Multi-layer belt drying that takes extruded feed down to safe moisture gently and evenly — the partner machine to every extruder.

title: Dry Extruder
lead: Friction-cooked extrusion without a boiler — the straightforward route to full-fat soya and small-line pet food.
body_paragraphs: The SPHG dry extruder generates its cooking heat through barrel friction alone, so plants without steam can still produce full-fat extruded soya and simple pet rations.
It suits smaller operations and ingredient pre-treatment inside larger SEMZON lines.
meta_description: Friction-cooked extrusion without a boiler — the straightforward route to full-fat soya and small-line pet food.

title: Fish Feed Extruder
lead: Wet extrusion for floating and sinking aqua feed and pet food — cooked, expanded and shaped in one conditioned pass.
body_paragraphs: The SMHS wet extruder steam-conditions the ration, then cooks and expands it through the barrel and die, producing floating or sinking pellets by recipe and die selection. Starch gelatinisation improves water stability and digestibility for fish, shrimp and pets.
Paired with the SHGW dryer and coating equipment it forms the core of SEMZON aqua and pet feed lines from 2 to 20 t/h.
features: Floating and sinking product from one machine
Steam pre-conditioning for cook and stability
Die sets for species and pellet sizes
Pairs with SHGW belt dryer and coater

spec_table.label: Products
spec_table.value: Floating / sinking aqua feed · pet food

meta_title: Fish Feed Extruder — SMHS | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: Wet extrusion for floating and sinking aqua feed and pet food — cooked, expanded and shaped in one conditioned pass.

title: Storage Tanks
lead: Fabricated storage from one tonne to one hundred — raw material bins, finished-product silos and liquid tanks built in our Lahore works.
body_paragraphs: SEMZON fabricates mild-steel storage tanks and bins from 1 to 100 tonnes: intake bins, batching bins above the mixer, finished-feed silos and liquid storage for oils and molasses.
Discharge geometry, level sensing and access are engineered per material so what goes in comes out — first in, first out, no bridging.
features: Liquid tanks for oils and molasses
meta_description: Fabricated storage from one tonne to one hundred — raw material bins, finished-product silos and liquid tanks built in our Lahore works.

title: Hammer Mill
lead: High-throughput grinding that sets up everything downstream — particle size decided here determines mixing accuracy and pellet durability three stages later.
body_paragraphs: The SMSP hammer mill reduces cleaned maize, wheat and meal to a uniform 500–700 µm grind through a high-speed beater rotor and interchangeable screens. Screen apertures are swapped in minutes to match ration and species, so one mill serves mash, pellet and crumb programmes alike.
Every SMSP is fabricated and trial-run in our Lahore works, balanced as an assembly, and matched to your line's magnet, feeder and aspiration so the grinding section runs dust-tight at rated load.
features: Capacities across the 2–35 t/h feed-line range
Reversible beaters for extended wear life
Direct spares support from the Lahore works
meta_description: High-throughput grinding that sets up everything downstream — particle size decided here determines mixing accuracy and pellet durability three stages

title: Automatic Liquid Adding
lead: Automatic, recipe-driven dosing of multiple liquids — oil, molasses, enzymes — weighed and delivered per batch by the control system.
body_paragraphs: The automatic liquid adding system stores, weighs and injects several liquids per recipe, under PLC control, so each batch receives exactly what the formulation calls for without operator handling.
It closes the loop between the batching computer and the mixer for consistent finished-feed analysis.
meta_title: Automatic Liquid Adding — ALA | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: Automatic, recipe-driven dosing of multiple liquids — oil, molasses, enzymes — weighed and delivered per batch by the control system.

title: Oil Adding Machine
lead: Tank, pump and spray manifold that puts a measured shot of oil into every batch — evenly, on time, without puddling.
body_paragraphs: The oil adding set meters fats and oils into the mixer through spray nozzles timed to the mixing cycle, so liquid lands on moving material and disperses evenly instead of streaking the batch.
Tank heating and insulated lines are specified for viscous fats in cold weather.
features: Tank heating options for viscous fats
meta_title: Oil Adding Machine — OIL | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: Tank, pump and spray manifold that puts a measured shot of oil into every batch — evenly, on time, without puddling.

title: Twin-Shaft Paddle Mixer
lead: Twin-shaft paddle action for the shortest cycles and the gentlest handling — built for high-liquid and fragile-ingredient rations.
body_paragraphs: The SMSJ twin-shaft paddle mixer fluidises the batch between counter-rotating paddle shafts, reaching CV ≤ 5% in an even shorter cycle than ribbon mixing while treating heat-sensitive and fragile ingredients gently.
It is the mixer of choice where high liquid percentages — molasses, fat, oil — would overload a ribbon machine.
features: Very short mixing cycles at CV ≤ 5%
meta_title: Twin-Shaft Paddle Mixer — SMSJ | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: Twin-shaft paddle action for the shortest cycles and the gentlest handling — built for high-liquid and fragile-ingredient rations.

title: Ribbon Mixer
lead: Batch mixing to a coefficient of variation of 5% or better in a 90–120 second cycle — the accuracy heart of the batching section.
body_paragraphs: The SMHY horizontal ribbon mixer blends macro ingredients, micro-doses and added liquids into a homogeneous batch in 90–120 seconds, holding CV at or below 5% across the 250–2000 kg batch range.
Full-length bomb-door discharge empties the batch fast and clean, keeping cycle times tight and cross-contamination low between rations.
features: Liquid adding ports for oil and additives
meta_description: Batch mixing to a coefficient of variation of 5% or better in a 90–120 second cycle — the accuracy heart of the batching section.

title: Packing Scales
lead: Weigh, fill, stitch, dispatch — finished feed into accurate 25 and 50 kg bags at the pace of the line.
body_paragraphs: SEMZON packing stations weigh finished feed into 25 or 50 kg bags with load-cell accuracy, then carry them across a stitching conveyor to the dispatch bay.
Bagging rate is matched to line capacity so packing never becomes the bottleneck at the end of a good production day.
meta_description: Weigh, fill, stitch, dispatch — finished feed into accurate 25 and 50 kg bags at the pace of the line.

title: Feed Pellet Mill
lead: The heart of the plant — steam-conditioned mash pressed through precision ring dies at 80–85 °C, from 2 to 35 tonnes every hour.
body_paragraphs: The SZLH series covers the full SEMZON feed-line range with ring dies from Ø350 to Ø768 mm. Mash is conditioned with saturated steam to 80–85 °C — up to triple-pass conditioning on larger frames — then pressed into dense, durable pellets.
Gear-driven transmission, quick die clamping and roller adjustment keep changeovers short, and every die and roller set is supported with spares from the Lahore works for the life of the machine.
features: Ring dies Ø350–768 mm across the series
Steam conditioning at 80–85 °C, up to triple conditioner
Quick die clamp and roller adjustment
Dies, rollers and wear parts ex-Lahore
meta_title: Feed Pellet Mill — SZLH | SEMZON Engineering
meta_description: The heart of the plant — steam-conditioned mash pressed through precision ring dies at 80–85 °C, from 2 to 35 tonnes every hour.

title: Pellet Crumbler
lead: Corrugated-roll crumbling that turns cooled pellets into uniform starter and grower crumbs — up to four-roll configurations.
body_paragraphs: The SSLG crumbler passes cooled pellets between corrugated rolls to produce crumbs for young birds and small species, with roll gap adjustment setting crumb size on the run.
A bypass flap sends whole pellets straight through when crumbs are not required, so one line serves both products.
meta_description: Corrugated-roll crumbling that turns cooled pellets into uniform starter and grower crumbs — up to four-roll configurations.

title: Vibration Screener
lead: Rotary vibration grading that splits pellets and crumbs into precise size fractions — uniform product forward, everything else back.
body_paragraphs: The SFJH screener grades cooled pellets and crumbled product across multiple decks, sending on-size feed to packing and returning fines and oversize for reprocessing.
Deck screens are matched to your crumb sizes and pellet diameters, and swap quickly between production runs.
features: Multi-deck grading of pellets and crumbs
meta_description: Rotary vibration grading that splits pellets and crumbs into precise size fractions — uniform product forward, everything else back.
